title.value: Machine-learning-based arc selection for constrained shortest path problems in column generation
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the focus on using machine learning to improve arc selection in constrained shortest path problems within the context of column generation.
title.quote: Machine-learning-based arc selection for constrained shortest path problems in column generation

extractions.description: The paper proposes a machine-learning-based heuristic pricing algorithm to reduce the computational time of solving constrained shortest path problems (SPPRC) in column generation methods. By training a machine learning model on data from previous executions, the algorithm selects arcs that are more likely to be part of the optimal solution, thus reducing the network size and speeding up the pricing problem. This approach is tested on vehicle and crew scheduling problems and vehicle routing problems with time windows, achieving significant reductions in computational time.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on optimizing computational methods for constrained shortest path problems using machine learning in operational contexts like vehicle and crew scheduling, but it does not centralize on climate or ecological sustainable development themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The method has been applied to two specific problems: the vehicle and crew scheduling problem in public transit and the vehicle routing problem with time windows. Reductions in computational time of up to 40% can be obtained.

primary_category.justification: The paper's focus is on computational optimization in routing and scheduling through machine learning and does not align with any direct climate or ecological sustainable development goals.
primary_category.quote: The goal of the project is to reduce the size of the underlying SPPRC network by keeping only the most promising arcs, therefore obtaining a reduced network.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no secondary themes related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
secondary_categories.quote: The focus is more on crew scheduling and vehicle routing problems, where in most cases, the PP is a shortest path problem with resource constraints or one of its variants, and it is most likely the part that consumes the largest portion of the computing time.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not directly fit into any specific sub-category of climate or ecological sustainable development.

applications.quote: The method has been applied to two specific problems: the vehicle and crew scheduling problem in public transit.
